declarations.name: Causal.loopFan_locallyStronglyCausal
declarations.standing: a lies in loopLow (height < 1). A point with x ≠ 0 lies in loopSide. A point with x = 0 other than a is the top of some γ_n (eq_half_of_loopγ_fst) and lies in loopCap n. Each of the three is StronglyCausalOn (below).

declarations.name: Causal.loopFan_stronglyCausalOn_low / _side / _cap
declarations.statement: loopFan.StronglyCausalOn loopLow; loopFan.StronglyCausalOn loopSide; ∀ n, loopFan.StronglyCausalOn (loopCap n)
declarations.standing: Each uses loopFan_stronglyCausalOn_of_boxes (:262): small centred boxes, convex in W, give StronglyCausalOn W. Convexity comes from loopFan_causallyConvexIn_box (:223): a box inside W is causally convex in W once every tent piece inside W that passes its tent's top, with both ends in the box, has that top below the box's ceiling. loopLow and loopSide hold no top, so this holds vacuously. In loopCap n the only top is γ_n's (loopPeak_mem_cap_iff, :332). A box about that top is above it. A box about another point is narrower than |x| and so holds no two points on either side of a top.

declarations.name: Causal.loopFan_stronglyCausalOn_low_not_at
declarations.statement: loopA ∈ loopLow ∧ loopFan.StronglyCausalOn loopLow ∧ ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 loopA, ∀ V ∈ 𝓝 loopA, V ⊆ U → ¬ loopFan.CausallyConvexIn V ⊤
declarations.standing: the title's 'strongly causal in [a neighbourhood] about a, though not at a in M', with loopFan_not_stronglyCausalAt. The Probe derives the ladder's ball of radius 1/2 by StronglyCausalOn.mono.

declarations.name: Causal.ArcCoherent.mem_diamond_on, Causal.ArcCoherent.causallyConvexIn_on
declarations.statement: for coherent arcs, a point of the diamond of U is the first end or a point of one arc piece inside U between the ends; a subset of U convex along every arc piece inside U is causally convex in U
declarations.standing: general (any space, any index type). These are the U-forms of Causal.ArcCoherent.mem_diamond and ArcCoherent.causallyConvexIn (Causal/GHWithoutTarentin.lean), which are stated for ⊤ only.

Prop:GH_fortement_causal's tarentin cannot be traded for local strong causality. The loop fan is T2, second countable, globally hyperbolic, causally arc-connected, absolutely minimal on every open set, locally strongly causal, with a time function, and is strongly causal in neither form. The ladder matrix reads single premises only, so it does not show this conjunctive fact (globally_hyperbolic ∧ locally_strongly_causal ∧ time_function ⇏ strongly_causal). It is a conjunct-level reading of the witness.

On the ladder's loop-fan argument (the [[open]] section comment, the loop fan's bullet, and the two [[open]] notes → strongly_causal, → strongly_causal_open): 'the ball W of radius 1/2 about a meets each tent in two arcs near its feet' is imprecise but harmless. The ball misses γ_0 entirely: ε_0 = 1, and its points with |x| < 1/2 are above height 1. It also does not contain γ_1's feet (±1/2, 0), which lie at distance exactly 1/2. The Lean proof uses the larger open set loopLow (height < 1), which contains the ball. The 'every other point has a neighbourhood meeting one arc only' step is not needed. Off the vertical through a, the set x ≠ 0 holds no tent top. At the top of γ_n, the band of heights (1 + ε_{n+1}, 1 + 2ε_n − ε_{n+1}) holds no other top. In both cases a box is convex by monotonicity alone.

The loop fan is causally open in all four forms (causally_open, causally_open_future and their local forms). This is argued, not in Lean: every point of a tent has a neighbourhood meeting that tent only, and on one tent J^±_U(V) is a set of parameters open in [0, 1]. It moves no pair (simulation D), so it is not stated. With it, and with conjuncts 20–21, the loop fan would decide all 21 causality-sort nodes.

kb_proposals: Local strong causality is separated both ways on ETT-layer models. The symmetric rational line lacks it at every point: no open set holding a point is StronglyCausalOn, Causal.symmRationalLine_not_stronglyCausalOn. The loop fan has it and is strongly causal in neither form: Causal.loopFan_locallyStronglyCausal. The full forms are Causal.symmRationalLine_separates_locallyStronglyCausal and Causal.loopFan_separates_locallyStronglyCausal (CausalScaffold.LscSeparations; T-abs-lsc-separations).

StronglyCausalOn W for an arc causality in the plane: the centred boxes are causally convex in W once no tent piece inside W passes a top it does not stay below (Causal.loopFan_causallyConvexIn_box). Choose W to hold no top (loopLow, loopSide) or a single top (loopCap n). No 'neighbourhood meeting one arc only' is needed. ArcCoherent.mem_diamond_on and causallyConvexIn_on are the U-forms of the ⊤-only lemmas of Causal.GHWithoutTarentin.
